name: Pacific mistletoe
desc: Pacific mistletoe (Phoradendron leucarpum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phoradendron leucarpum is a species of mistletoe in the Viscaceae family. Its common names include American mistletoe, eastern mistletoe, hairy mistletoe and oak mistletoe.
